title: What if you tried to float away with party balloons?

lines.vo: What if you tried to float away with nothing but party balloons?
One helium balloon lifts only about ten grams.
lines.cap: One helium balloon lifts only about 10 grams.

lines.vo: But you weigh around a hundred and fifty pounds.
So you'd need about seven thousand balloons.
A cloud as big as a small house.
Higher up, the air thins, and the balloons swell.
Then they start popping, one by one.
And helium leaks out of latex in about half a day.
So your flight ends in a slow, sad sink. Follow for more what ifs.
